episodes.title: Part 1 of 2
episodes.summary: From humble beginnings at circus sideshows to sold-out concert halls in Europe, Part 1 of Houdini follows the rise of the boy Erich Weiss as he becomes the man Harry Houdini, master escapologist.

episodes.title: Part 2 of 2
episodes.summary: Conclusion. Houdini must adapt as the industrial age comes to an end.
